note: 作文高分短语与固定搭配，本站按功能分类原创整理；例句为本站编写的通用句式，不是真题原文，也不是官方范文。

groups.title: 开头段：引出话题
groups.intro: 开头只做两件事：把话题点出来，把立场亮出来。先用一个普遍现象起句，再用转折把焦点收窄到本题。

items.slot: 时间状语，适合现象列举型开头
items.example: In recent years, an increasing number of students have turned to online courses.

items.slot: 引述共识，后面接完整句子
items.example: It is widely acknowledged that reading widely broadens the mind.

items.en: there is a growing concern over
items.slot: 引出有争议的公共话题
items.example: There is a growing concern over the pressure on young graduates.

items.slot: 强调式开头，适合比较型题目
items.example: Nothing is more important than a healthy balance between study and rest.
With the rapid development of technology, online learning has become routine.

items.en: as is vividly shown in the picture
items.zh: 如图中生动展示的那样
items.slot: 图画作文开头，承接图画描述
items.example: As is vividly shown in the picture, a young man is buried in his phone.

items.slot: 开头亮明立场，语气正式
items.example: It goes without saying that a clear plan saves time.

items.en: nowadays more and more people tend to
items.zh: 如今越来越多的人倾向于
items.slot: 描述趋势，后面接动词原形
items.example: Nowadays more and more people tend to shop through mobile apps.

items.en: the issue of ... has aroused wide discussion
items.slot: 引出热议话题，中间填名词
items.example: The issue of exam pressure has aroused wide discussion among parents.

items.slot: 引出话题的过渡开头，后面接名词或动名词
items.example: When it comes to choosing a career, personal interest matters a lot.

groups.title: 图表与图画：描述数据
groups.intro: 图表作文不写数字堆砌，写趋势和对比。一句话说清什么在变、变得快不快，再点出对比项。

items.example: Part-time jobs account for nearly a third of their income.

items.slot: 描述增长趋势，主语用时间或地点
items.example: The city has seen a sharp rise in bike sharing.

items.slot: 描述下降趋势，语气客观
items.example: The town witnessed a steady decline in water use.
The number of readers remained almost unchanged last year.

items.slot: 对比两组数据或两种情况
items.example: In sharp contrast to last year, paper sales dropped by half.

items.slot: 倍数比较，注意接可数名词
items.example: The library received twice as many visitors as the year before.
The proportion of female engineers stands at 38 percent.

items.en: there has been a marked increase in
items.slot: 现在完成时描述已完成的变化
items.example: There has been a marked increase in online lectures.

items.slot: 描述相近数值，避免绝对化
items.example: The two groups are roughly equal to each other in size.

items.en: the figure for ... is slightly higher than that for
items.example: The figure for urban families is slightly higher than that for rural ones.

groups.title: 表达观点与立场
groups.intro: 观点句一句就够，位置放在首段末或第二段首。写完立场，后面必须有理由接住，别让观点悬空。

items.slot: 亮明个人观点，后接完整句
items.example: From my perspective, the rule is reasonable but too strict.
I am firmly convinced that honesty pays in the long run.

items.en: as far as I am concerned
items.example: As far as I am concerned, teamwork matters more than talent.

items.en: it is reasonable to argue that
items.slot: 论证型立场，比 in my opinion 更正式
items.example: It is reasonable to argue that part-time work trains independence.

items.en: I side with those who believe that
items.example: I side with those who believe that effort outweighs luck.
In my eyes, a good teacher listens first.

items.zh: 这一观点值得认真考虑
items.slot: 评价他人观点，适合讨论型作文
items.example: This view deserves serious consideration before we make a decision.

items.en: I can hardly agree with the idea that
items.slot: 反对型立场，后面必须给理由
items.example: I can hardly agree with the idea that money decides success.

groups.title: 原因段：解释为什么会这样
groups.intro: 原因段最忌一句话一个原因。用两种句式把原因分层：直接原因用 contribute to，根本原因用 stem from。

items.slot: 中性或正面原因，后接名词或动名词
items.example: Regular exercise contributes to better sleep.
Long delays gave rise to widespread complaints.
Much of the anxiety stems from unrealistic expectations.
The improvement can be attributed to better planning.
Many students try new apps out of curiosity.
Under enormous pressure, some students skip breakfast.
A lack of sleep weakens memory.

items.slot: 相关性表述，不作因果断言
items.example: Their progress has much to do with daily practice.

items.slot: 正式论证原因，后接句子
items.example: The school changed the rule on the grounds that safety comes first.

items.slot: 引出多因之一，避免绝对
items.example: This is partly because information spreads much faster now.

groups.title: 举例与引用
groups.intro: 例子的作用是把抽象理由落地。一个具体场景胜过三句空话，但不要编造精确到小数点的假数据。

items.slot: 举例标志，中间填名词短语
items.example: Take my roommate as an example; he improved his writing in three months.
A case in point is the rise of mobile payment.

items.slot: 引出数据，不要编造过细结论
items.example: According to a recent survey, most freshmen worry about time management.
As the saying goes, practice makes perfect.

items.slot: 描述普遍现象，后接人加不定式
items.example: It is not uncommon for students to stay up before exams.

items.zh: 这一点在……中得到很好的说明
items.example: This is well illustrated by the growth of online libraries.

items.zh: 历史提供了有说服力的例子
items.example: History offers a telling example of how teamwork built great projects.

items.slot: 引导读者设想具体场景
items.example: Consider the case of a student who studies alone all day.

groups.title: 强调与递进
groups.intro: 强调句用在段中最关键的那一句，一段最多一次。用多了反而没有重点。

items.slot: 强调核心，后接名词或从句
items.example: What matters most is whether you keep going.
More importantly, the habit lasts a lifetime.

items.slot: 强调句型，中间放被强调成分
items.example: It is daily practice that makes the difference.

items.slot: 递进，注意两端结构对称
items.example: Reading is not merely a habit but also a way of thinking.
Above all, be honest with your readers.
He cannot finish one book, let alone ten.

items.slot: 否定并纠正误解，后接名词
items.example: Far from being a waste of time, review saves time.
This is precisely why we need a clear schedule.

groups.title: 对比与让步
groups.intro: 先让一步再转折，是议论文最稳的写法。让步句承认对方合理之处，转折句给出自己的判断。

items.en: on the one hand ... on the other hand
items.slot: 双面论述，注意两面都要写
items.example: On the one hand, phones help us study; on the other hand, they distract us.

items.slot: 先让步，下一句必须转折
items.example: Admittedly, the plan costs time at the start.
While it is true that talent helps, effort decides the result.

items.slot: 对比选择，注意前后结构一致
items.example: We should plan the week rather than the day.
In spite of the rain, the reading room was full.
There is no denying that mistakes are part of learning.

items.slot: 句间转折副词，需与前句形成对照
items.example: The task is hard; nevertheless, it is worth doing.
By contrast, the second group improved twice as fast.

items.slot: 从句对比，前后必须平行
items.example: Some prefer debate, whereas others prefer quiet reading.

items.slot: 防止过度推论，后接句子
items.example: It does not follow that a higher price means better quality.

groups.title: 影响与结果
groups.intro: 写影响要分时间层级：眼前结果用 result in，长期结果用 the long-term consequences of。

items.example: Social media has a profound impact on how teenagers read.

items.slot: 后接结果，主语多为行为
items.example: Careless planning results in wasted time.
He gained speed at the cost of accuracy.
The long-term consequences of burning out are easy to underestimate.

items.slot: 正面效果，主语多用方法或工具
items.example: A clear checklist improves your efficiency.
Cut corners repeatedly, and the plan is bound to fail.

items.slot: 负面消耗，多接健康或精力
items.example: Late nights take a toll on your health.
Small habits bring about lasting change.

items.en: leave ... with little choice but to
items.slot: 被动后果，后接动词原形
items.example: The flood left the village with little choice but to rebuild.

items.slot: 落脚到具体后果，后接句子
items.example: The immediate effect is that fewer students copy homework.

groups.title: 建议段：怎么解决
groups.intro: 建议段写两层：谁来做，怎么做。不要只写 should，否则整段是空的。

items.slot: 建议段起句，后接动词原形
items.example: The university should take effective measures to reduce plastic use.
Campaigns can raise public awareness of data privacy.
Make full use of the library before you buy new books.
Students should strike a balance between study and exercise.
Parents set a good example for their children.
Schools should keep a close eye on screen time.
The city is committed to cutting carbon emissions.
Give priority to the task that blocks others.

items.slot: 温和建议，后接动词原形
items.example: It is advisable to review new words the next day.

items.en: only by working together can we
items.zh: 只有共同努力我们才能
items.example: Only by working together can we protect the river.

groups.title: 结尾段：总结与展望
groups.intro: 结尾不写新观点。第一句收结论，第二句给条件或展望，两句话足够。

items.example: In conclusion, habits shape results.
To sum up, the benefits outweigh the risks.

items.slot: 虚拟语气，后面用过去式
items.example: It is high time that we took rest seriously.
As long as you keep reading, progress will come.
Today's practice paves the way for tomorrow's confidence.

items.en: only in this way can we
items.slot: 倒装结尾，承接前面的措施
items.example: Only in this way can we make study sustainable.

items.en: a bright future awaits those who
items.zh: 美好的未来属于那些……的人
items.example: A bright future awaits those who keep learning.

items.en: there is every reason to believe that
items.example: There is every reason to believe that the trend will continue.

items.en: the sooner we act, the better
items.example: The sooner we act, the better our chances are.

items.en: let us start with small steps
items.example: Let us start with small steps and see where they lead.

groups.title: 小作文：书信与通知常用表达
groups.intro: 小作文看格式和礼貌层级。开头一句说明写信目的，结尾一句给联系方式或期待回复，中间才是内容。

items.slot: 书信开头，后接动词原形
items.example: I am writing to apply for the position of campus guide.

items.en: I would appreciate it if you could
items.zh: 如果您能……我将不胜感激
items.slot: 礼貌请求，后接动词原形
items.example: I would appreciate it if you could reply before Friday.

items.en: I am writing to express my sincere gratitude for
items.zh: 我写信是为了对……表达诚挚的感谢
items.example: I am writing to express my sincere gratitude for your generous help.

items.en: I apologize for any inconvenience caused
items.zh: 对由此造成的不便我深表歉意
items.example: I apologize for any inconvenience caused by the delay.

items.en: please feel free to contact me at
items.example: Please feel free to contact me at 12345678.

items.en: I am looking forward to your reply
items.example: I am looking forward to your reply at your earliest convenience.
All are welcome to attend the lecture on Friday evening.

items.en: I am writing to inform you that
items.slot: 通知正式开头，后接句子
items.example: I am writing to inform you that the meeting has been moved.

items.en: it would be a great honor for me to
items.example: It would be a great honor for me to introduce the guest speaker.

items.en: I would like to make a suggestion regarding
items.example: I would like to make a suggestion regarding the library hours.

items.en: your prompt attention to this matter would be highly appreciated
items.zh: 如您能及时处理此事，不胜感激
items.slot: 正式催促，适合投诉或申请信
items.example: Your prompt attention to this matter would be highly appreciated.

items.en: please let me know if you need any further information
items.example: Please let me know if you need any further information about my application.

groups.title: 衔接词链：让段落接得上
groups.intro: 衔接词不是装饰，是逻辑标记。一段里最多两到三个，用多了会显得分不清主次。

items.example: To begin with, the cost is affordable.
What is more, the plan is easy to follow.
In addition, the app works offline.
As a result, more students joined the club.
Consequently, the number of readers doubled.
In other words, the rule rewards consistency.
From a long-term perspective, the change is worth the cost.
By the same token, rest improves focus.
In the meantime, teachers updated their lesson plans.
On the whole, the experiment went smoothly.
That is to say, the rule applies to everyone.
Last but not least, remember to proofread.

groups.title: 四级高频动词搭配
groups.intro: 这类搭配考的是介词，不是词义。写作时用错介词比用错单词更显眼，背的时候连着后面的词一起记。

items.example: She is good at explaining difficult ideas.
Many teenagers are interested in short videos.
Over 300 students took part in the survey.

items.slot: to 是介词，后接名词或动名词
items.example: Pay attention to the words in bold.
The result depends on how you plan.
Each member is responsible for one part.

items.slot: to 后接名词或动名词
items.example: Freshmen soon get used to campus life.

items.slot: to 是介词，后接名词或动名词
items.example: I look forward to hearing from you.

items.slot: 可加 to 引出对象
items.example: Small efforts make a difference.
She is in charge of the reading club.

items.slot: 转折过渡，纠正前文预期
items.example: As a matter of fact, the second plan is cheaper.
We keep in touch with our teachers after graduation.
She spends an hour reading every night.
I would rather walk than wait for the bus.

groups.title: 六级与考研高频搭配
groups.intro: 这一组是学术写作的骨架搭配，议论文里几乎每段都能用上一个。注意 to 是介词还是不定式符号。

items.slot: 万能积极句，后接名词或动名词
items.example: Teamwork plays an important role in long projects.
Schools attach importance to mental health.

items.slot: 后接名词，或用 that 从句
items.example: More people are aware of the risk of oversharing.
We should take the cost into account.
The program gives full play to student creativity.
Children are exposed to advertisements every day.
It takes time to make sense of the data.

items.slot: 后接名词，注意与 face 的区别
items.example: Graduates are faced with many choices.
Rural students now have access to online courses.
In terms of speed, the new system wins.

items.slot: 后接名词，多用于规则与条件
items.example: The schedule is subject to change.
The study sheds light on how habits form.
Beginners are prone to overplanning.
The interview gives an insight into campus life.

groups.title: 常考话题固定搭配
groups.intro: 话题词要成组备：环保一组、科技一组、教育一组。考场上直接调用，比临场拼词稳得多。

items.example: Environmental protection starts with small habits.
The city is working toward sustainable development.
Climate change affects farming seasons.
Technological innovation changed how we learn.
Digital literacy is now part of basic education.
Schools are paying more attention to mental health.
A work-life balance keeps energy steady.
Volunteers help protect cultural heritage.
Public transport reduces traffic pressure.
Lifelong learning keeps skills fresh.
Online privacy deserves clear rules.
Food safety requires strict inspection.
